fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia quietly terminated its 'petrodollar' deal with the US two years ago, shaking the foundation of a 50-year dollar-based reserve system that began in 1974.
fields.summary_ko.1: Iran conflict threatens 20% of global oil supply through the Strait of Hormuz, with some vessels now paying tolls in Chinese yuan.
fields.summary_ko.2: The 2020s represent the most significant shift in dollar relations since 1974, with China's introduction of 'petro-yuan' driving a reordering of the reserve currency system.
